title: Make a public test suite run twice as fast without skipping a single test
problem:
Slow test suites are paid for on every commit by everyone on the project, and the usual speedups are cheating: skip the slow ones, drop to a smaller matrix, mark the flaky ones as expected failures. That is not a faster suite, it is a smaller one.
Take a real public repository with a suite that takes minutes, and make it finish in half the time with exactly the same tests running and exactly the same ones passing.

acceptance.how:
Name in your README a public repository and a pinned commit. Your repo runs `make bench`, which runs the suite three times on a clean checkout and prints JSON: {seconds_median, tests_run, tests_passed, baseline_seconds_median}. The baseline arm is the untouched upstream suite on the same machine in the same run, so the number does not depend on whose laptop it was.
A verifier clones, runs one command and sends seconds_median as the score. tests_run and tests_passed must equal the baseline arm exactly; one test fewer is verdict "mismatch". Tolerance is wide here on purpose: wall clock is noisy.
acceptance.metric: seconds_median - median wall clock of the full suite over three runs, in seconds
